threads.subject: Security Disclosure: Potential SSRF in webhook validation endpoint
threads.rawBody:
Hello Security Team,

During independent vulnerability assessment under your responsible disclosure program, we identified a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) flaw in /api/v1/webhooks/test-delivery.

The endpoint fails to validate private RFC 1918 IPv4 ranges, allowing an authenticated user to pivot to internal AWS metadata services (169.254.169.254) and retrieve IAM credentials.

Full proof of concept script and curl logs attached. Awaiting your PGP key or encrypted acknowledgment.

Priya Sharma, CISSP
Lead Security Researcher
